text:
DeployBot: Starting staged enable for model nova-13b-quant-v2
DeployBot: rollout plan -> regions: global (priority eu,us), change_window: 03:00-05:00 UTC, slices: 5% -> 25% -> 100%
DeployBot: fallback_order: nova-13b-int8-v1, nova-13b-fp16-v1, nova-12b-stable
DeployBot: manifest preview:
```
model_id: nova-13b-quant-v2
canary_steps: [5,25,100]
fallback_order: [nova-13b-int8-v1,nova-13b-fp16-v1,nova-12b-stable]
rollback_thresholds:
  p95_latency_ms: 300
  error_rate_pct_delta: 2
  unsafe_token_rate: 0.5
```

morgan: @sara quick q — are dedicated customers auto-pinned to older model variants during this rollout or do we need to add pin entries?

kai: adding pin list for known enterprise tenants now: `customer_pins: {acme: nova-12b-stable, globex: nova-13b-fp16-v1}`

sara: safety gates: if p95 > 300ms OR error_rate increases by >2% for 3 consecutive mins we pause and fallback. I'll own rollback trigger.

alex: linked dashboards: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/nova-rollouts/nova-13b-quant (watch token-level cost + latency tabs) :eyes:

jo: ops oncall here — will be watching eu-west-1 during the 03:00 window, escalate to SRE if tail latency spikes. :shipit:

DeployBot: Canaries started: 5% rollout initiated (tranche 1) — deployed to eu-west-1 and us-east-1 at 03:07 UTC

morgan: seeing a small increase in tail latency in eu-west-1 p95 ~ 290ms, p99 unchanged

kai: traffic split verified, no config drift from manifest

DeployBot: Canary update: tranche 1 stable at 5% for 7m. Advancing to 25% in 5m unless gates trip.

sara: hold — i'm seeing a rise in timeouts for streaming sessions tied to large context prompts. p99 latency jumped to 480ms in eu-west-1. Pausing advance.

jo: acknowledged, holding advance. Ops creating a scoped incident for the stream timeouts.

OpsBot: Incident created INC-2026: nova-streaming-timeouts-eu, severity: P2, assignees: jo,sara

morgan: logs snippet of interest:
```
[2024-04-11T03:15:12Z] nova-13b-quant-v2 | stream_init_ms: 820 | kv_cache_hit: false | node: gpu-23
```

sara: root cause hypothesis: quant path has an edge case with long-context KV eviction. Plan: roll back canaries to fallback_order[0] (nova-13b-int8-v1) while we patch.

alex: agree — also switch routing to prefer nova-13b-int8 for eu-west-1 only, keep us-east on quant for now.

kai: applied routing override: `region_overrides: {eu-west-1: nova-13b-int8-v1}`

DeployBot: Initiating automated rollback to fallback nova-13b-int8-v1 for affected slices. Rolling user traffic now.

DeployBot: Rollback progress: 60% -> 100% for eu-west-1, us-east unaffected. No config drift detected.

sara: monitoring metrics — p99 down to 220ms, error rate back to baseline. Good cut.

jo: ops confirm: incident downgraded, continue postmortem after patch deploy.

morgan: opened quick ticket for quant KV eviction fix: TASK-4872

DeployBot: Canary aborted for nova-13b-quant-v2. Holding full rollout until postmortem + patch. Notifying release owners.

sara: we'll re-run a smaller canary once TASK-4872 is validated. Recommend adding `kv_eviction_grace_ms: 500` as a temporary mitigation.

alex: noted, I'll update the runbook with the rollback timeline and customer pin impacts.

DeployBot: Notify: rollout paused -> requires manual enable after confirmation from release leads.

morgan: thanks everyone. I'll draft release note addendum re: paused quant rollout and affected regions.

sara: postmortem sync tomorrow 10:00 PST. I'll invite SRE + runtime devs.

DeployBot: Thread closed by DeployBot at 1723460150 — awaiting human re-enable.
